sentences.text:
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

3. The petitioner is aggrieved by the order dated 18.07.2023 passed by the learned J.M.F.C.,
Chhendipada in G.R. Case No.664 of 2022, whereby cognizance of offences punishable under Sections 420/468/471/34 of the IPC has been taken against the petitioner and others.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a practicing lawyer and he has only signed on the Sale Deed as a witness.
Therefore, the complicity of the petitioner in the present case can't be imagined.
Even if the allegation made in the charge sheet and the documents form of charge sheet is taken at its face value, no case worth the name would be made out against the present petitioner.
5. I am not inclined to entertain this petition at the stage of cognizance as I find no infirmity in the impugned order.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to move application under Section 239 of Cr.P.C. before the learned Court below seeking discharge.
If such an application is moved, the same shall be considered on its own merits.
It is expected that the learned Court below shall pass a detailed order on the the facts of the present case.
6. With this observation, the CRLMC is disposed of.
